rows.verbatim: (c) Include the substance of this clause, including this paragraph (c), in all subcontracts with small business concerns, including subcontracts with small business concerns for the acquisition of commercial products or commercial services.
rows.normalized: Contractor must include the substance of FAR 52.232-40, including paragraph (c), in all subcontracts with small business concerns.

rows.verbatim: The payment request must comply with the requirements identified in FAR 32.905(b), ‘‘Content of Invoices’’ and the applicable Payment clause included in this contract.
rows.normalized: A payment request submitted by the Contractor must comply with FAR 32.905(b) Content of Invoices and the applicable Payment clause.

rows.verbatim: (b) Except as provided in paragraph (c) of this clause, the Contractor shall submit payment requests electronically using the Department of Treasury Invoice Processing Platform (IPP) or successor system.
rows.normalized: Contractor shall submit payment requests electronically via IPP or successor system, except as provided in paragraph (c).

rows.verbatim: (c) The Contractor may submit payment requests using other than IPP only when the Contracting Officer authorizes alternate procedures in writing in accordance with HHS procedures.
rows.normalized: Contractor may submit payment requests other than via IPP only when the Contracting Officer authorizes alternate procedures in writing per HHS procedures.

rows.verbatim: (d) If alternate payment procedures are authorized, the Contractor shall include a copy of the Contracting Officer’s written authorization with each payment request.
rows.normalized: If alternate payment procedures are authorized, Contractor shall include a copy of the Contracting Officer's written authorization with each payment request.
